test_item_verbatim: · The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig a) The Head Unit shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = [SNA] when BH-CAN STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig is missing

tcs.tc_title: gate VehicleSpeedVSOSig to VehicleSpeedVSOSig, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h)
2. Read vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig and check that it reports the value sent in step 1
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = 205 (12.8125 km/h) is sent
2. vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig reports the same value and is sent over LVDS
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
· The Head Unit shall gate BH-CAN STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig a) The Head Unit shall send LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig = [SNA] when BH-CAN STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig is missing

(gate VehicleSpeedVSOSig to VehicleSpeedVSOSig, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V3-280` 主句之「HU 將 BH-CAN `STATUS_CCAN3.VehicleSpeedVSOSig` gate 至 LVDS `vehicleUpdate_2.VehicleSpeedVSOSig`」。供試值取 P363 DBC 之實測（`STATUS_CCAN3`）。依 R-CAM15(b)，V3 列只承 376。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
